mapper.select: -- 로그인 아이디로 사용자 식별자를 조회한다. SELECT u.id FROM users u WHERE u.login_id = #{loginId} AND u.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
-- 관리자 기본정보 입력 대상 회원 존재 여부를 조회한다. SELECT count(1) FROM users u WHERE u.id = #{userId}

-- 사용자 기본정보를 조회한다. SELECT mp.user_id, mp.birth_year, mp.region_code, mp.postal_code, mp.road_address, mp.jibun_address, mp.detail_address, mp.sido_name, mp.sigungu_name, mp.eupmyeondong_name, mp.legal_dong_code, mp.road_name_code, mp.building_management_no, mp.address_source_code, mp.has_income, mp.income_presence_code, mp.income_amount, mp.health_insurance_basis_code FROM member_profiles mp WHERE mp.user_id = #{userId}

-- 사용자 사업자 기본정보를 조회한다. SELECT bp.id AS business_profile_id, bp.representative_name, bp.business_registration_no, bp.business_name, bp.workplace_region_code, bp.workplace_postal_code, bp.workplace_road_address, bp.workplace_jibun_address, bp.workplace_detail_address, bp.workplace_sido_name, bp.workplace_sigungu_name, bp.workplace_eupmyeondong_name, bp.workplace_legal_dong_code, bp.workplace_road_name_code, bp.workplace_building_management_no, bp.workplace_address_source_code, bp.opening_date, bp.ksic_code, bp.business_type_code, bp.company_stage_code, bp.annual_revenue, bp.annual_revenue_year, bp.employee_count, bp.regular_employee_count, bp.planned_hire_count, bp.nice_credit_score, bp.kcb_credit_score, bp.has_existing_loan, bp.has_policy_fund_usage, bp.has_guarantee_usage FROM business_profiles bp WHERE bp.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY bp.updated_at DESC, bp.created_at DESC, bp.id ASC LIMIT 1

-- 사용자 가족 기본정보 목록을 조회한다. SELECT fm.id AS family_member_id, fm.relation_type_code, fm.birth_year, fm.school_age_status_code, fm.enrollment_status_code, fm.is_cohabiting, fm.is_supported, fm.has_income, fm.income_presence_code, fm.income_amount FROM family_members fm WHERE fm.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE fm.relation_type_code WHEN 'SPOUSE' THEN 1 WHEN 'CHILD' THEN 2 WHEN 'PARENT' THEN 3 ELSE 9 END ASC, fm.birth_year ASC NULLS LAST, fm.created_at ASC, fm.id ASC

-- 사용자 기본정보 서류 입력에 사용할 표준 필드 목록을 조회한다. SELECT sdf.id AS standard_field_id, sdf.document_type_code, sdf.field_key, sdf.field_label, sdf.field_type_code, sdf.scope_code, sdf.required_default, sdf.sort_order, sdf.help_text FROM standard_document_fields sdf WHERE sdf.is_selectable = true ORDER BY CASE sdf.document_type_code WHEN 'BUSINESS_REGISTRATION' THEN 1 WHEN 'VAT_TAX_BASE' THEN 2 WHEN 'TAX_EXEMPT_INCOME' THEN 3 WHEN 'INCOME_CERTIFICATE' THEN 4 WHEN 'NATIONAL_TAX_PAID' THEN 5 WHEN 'LOCAL_TAX_PAID' THEN 6 WHEN 'RESIDENT_REGISTRATION' THEN 7 WHEN 'FAMILY_RELATION' THEN 8 WHEN 'HEALTH_INSURANCE_PAYMENT' THEN 9 WHEN 'HEALTH_INSURANCE_QUALIFICATION' THEN 10 ELSE 99 END ASC, sdf.sort_order ASC, sdf.field_label ASC
-- 사용자 서류별 입력값 목록을 조회한다. SELECT mdiv.standard_field_id, mdiv.value_text, mdiv.value_number, mdiv.value_date, mdiv.value_boolean FROM member_document_input_values mdiv WHERE mdiv.user_id = #{userId}

-- 사용자 간단 인터뷰 응답 목록을 조회한다. SELECT mir.question_code, mir.answer_code, mir.note FROM member_interview_responses mir WHERE mir.member_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE mir.question_code WHEN 'SAME_BUSINESS_IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 WHEN 'DUPLICATE_SUPPORT_USAGE' THEN 2 WHEN 'BUSINESS_ACTUALLY_OPERATING' THEN 3 WHEN 'OTHER_RESTRICTION' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END ASC
mapper.insert: -- 사용자 기본정보를 저장한다.
